description.en: Same as RunAttachAvatarUseMsg, but only shows the message without actually attaching the avatar (passes _atch as false to RunAttachAvatarEx) — used when the avatar was already attached elsewhere and only the announcement is needed.
Character ID substituted into the message.
Avatar ID substituted into the message.
Optional; accepted for signature compatibility but has no effect since no attachment happens (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show an avatar-attached message without actually attaching it
RunAttachAvatarOnlyMsgUseMsg("para_cp0009", "ck0003", "sysmes-Avatar-00001");
